usage: agentbreeder registry import [-h] [--as NAME] [--version X.Y.Z]
                                    [--project PROJECT]
                                    [--dry-run | --expect-digest SHA256]
                                    [--json]
                                    PATH

positional arguments:
  PATH                  A version directory

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --as NAME             Import under this name
  --version X.Y.Z       Import as this version
  --project PROJECT
  --dry-run             Check and hash a staged copy; write nothing
  --expect-digest SHA256
                        Refuse unless the staged copy has this digest (from
                        --dry-run)
  --json
